title: drone-in-a-box
description:
A prototype distributed Edge-to-Cloud system for automating industrial technical inspections (RaaS - Robot as a Service).

This project simulates a ground infrastructure (Hangar) and a flight unit (Drone) communicating in real time through a central MQTT broker, ensuring a secure, fault-tolerant architecture based on Finite State Machines (FSM).

title: concurrent-pool
description: A high-performance, multi-threaded physics simulation of a pool game developed in Java 21. The project focuses on advanced concurrent design patterns, spatial partitioning for collision optimization, custom synchronization barriers, and formal verification using Java PathFinder (JPF).

title: SmartHomePekkoCluster
description: A distributed, concurrent, and reactive smart home alarm control system built in Java using Apache Pekko Cluster, Cluster Receptionist, and Group Routers.

title: critical-section-MOM
description: A transparent, message-oriented middleware (MOM) providing distributed mutual exclusion using RabbitMQ.

title: tic-tac-toe-java-rmi
description: A distributed, multithreaded implementation of the classic Tic-Tac-Toe game built in Java. The project leverages Java RMI (Remote Method Invocation) for Remote Procedure Calls (RPC) and JavaFX for an interactive graphical user interface, strictly following distributed object computing and concurrent programming principles.

title: concurrent-fs-stat
description: A high-performance Java library that asynchronously computes recursive file size statistics across directory trees, implemented across three distinct concurrency paradigms. Developed as part of the Concurrent and Distributed Programming course.

title: Odds-and-Evens-Go
description: A concurrent implementation of the classic Odds-and-Evens game in Go, structured as a knockout tournament for N players.This project strictly adheres to a message-passing concurrency model with no shared memory (utilizing Go channels for all synchronization and data exchange).

title: SmartHomePekko
description: A concurrent, reactive smart home alarm control system built in Java using the Apache Pekko Actor Model framework. This project manages peripheral sensor networks, user keypad interactions, time delays, and multi-zone safety partitions in a fully asynchronous, thread-safe environment.

title: WheatYieldPredictor
description: A jupyter notebook exploring the problem of predicting the wheat yield of a country, based on several factors(population, rain, average temperature, etc...). This project tests and compares several ML Algorithms and provides a simple UI to interact with the best model.
